blueprint_tool_entry: the three dispatch paths PASS.md records today (F-b5-02 states the unit, F-b5-03 records three implementations and no contract between them; F-b5-01 names Dispatch as one of the two boundaries with no standard to adopt). The blueprint's own tool entry for the execution path is firecracker-cell@.service, which adapters/live.py targets
capability: dispatch seam with planner and judge
standard: none to adopt (F-b5-01, F-b5-02, F-b5-03: one unit executes and returns one result; today three implementations share no contract). The vocabularies the seam adopts are named by other skills and are unverified here: the task lifecycle for `state` (A2A), the stop-reason set for `stop_reason` (Agent Client Protocol), RFC 9457 for the failure body, JSON Schema 2020-12 for the published request schema, and the Idempotency-Key convention for the key

reuses.examples/end-to-end/run.py: the JSON Schema 2020-12 validator, the criterion store, and the deterministic unit that produces a step's text and cost - imported, not restated, so this harness and the worked example price and grade the same document the same way
reuses.examples/end-to-end/workflows/triage-and: the step tree the planner prices and the unit executes
reuses.examples/end-to-end/agents.json: the agent registry the model class of each step comes from
reuses.examples/end-to-end/entries/human.json: the entry envelope the dispatch request is built from

differs_in_execution_model: unit_lifetime: a session held open for the life of the unit vs one submit-and-poll into a separate process
cancellation_reach: stoppable at the next checkpoint vs not stoppable once started, so its honest terminal is cancel_timeout
cost read_mode: scan the records and fold vs fetch a materialised snapshot by digest

live.reached_over: a vsock control channel to a per-agent microVM, with model egress through the host broker
